title: Pocket Lantern — original lesson 3 procedural audio
provenance: Newly composed and synthesized for this course; no sampled recordings, third-party music, external services or third-party libraries.
method: Original C-major eight-bar melody over C/Am/F/G/C/Em/F/G; warm additive sine voices, bass, panned chord arpeggios and restrained filtered-noise percussion. Attack/release envelopes, channel DC removal, quiet edge taper and conservative peak normalization. Shoot is a descending oscillator chirp; hit is filtered noise with fixed low resonances.
runtime_requirement: None: the game loads the shipped WAV files directly.
reproducibility: Deterministic standard-library Python, explicit seed, little-endian PCM. SHA-256 identifies exact shipped bytes; verify repeated regeneration on the same Python/platform. Floating-point libm differences may alter least-significant PCM bits on another platform.
